# MOCA Codex Documentation

> Documentation files for Large Language Models

## Documentation

- [Query Guide](/query-guide.md): Complete guide to filtering, sorting, searching, and pagination in the MOCA Codex API
- [MOCA Codex API](/introduction.md): A comprehensive RESTful interface for accessing and managing the MOCA Codex knowledge base
- [Getting Started](/getting-started.md): Quick start guide for the MOCA Codex API
- [Files Endpoints](/files.md): API endpoints for retrieving files and assets from the MOCA Codex
- [Codex Endpoints](/codex.md): API endpoints for accessing and querying the MOCA Codex knowledge base
- [Examples](/examples/introduction.md): Interactive examples demonstrating common query patterns for the MOCA Codex API
- [Recent Files](/examples/files/recent-files.md): Get the most recently uploaded files
- [List Files](/examples/files/list-files.md): Retrieve a list of files with basic metadata
- [Get File Metadata](/examples/files/get-metadata.md): Retrieve detailed metadata for a specific file
- [Filter Images](/examples/files/filter-images.md): Get only image files from the collection
- [Custom Transformations](/examples/assets/transformations.md): Apply custom width, height, and format transformations
- [Sharp Transformations](/examples/assets/sharp.md): Use Sharp API for advanced image processing
- [Image Presets](/examples/assets/presets.md): Retrieve images using transformation presets
- [Exclude Null Values](/examples/advanced/exclude-null.md): Filter out items with null values in specific fields
- [Complex Filters](/examples/advanced/complex-filters.md): Combine multiple filters using logical operators
- [Sorting](/examples/codex/sorting.md): Sort codex items by various fields
- [Full-Text Search](/examples/codex/search.md): Search across all codex fields
- [Pagination](/examples/codex/pagination.md): Retrieve paginated results with total counts
- [List Items](/examples/codex/list-items.md): Retrieve all codex items with basic fields
- [Query by Owner](/examples/codex/items-by-owner.md): Query all codex items owned by a specific Ethereum wallet address
- [Get by ID](/examples/codex/get-by-id.md): Retrieve a specific codex item with all its details
- [Filter by Name](/examples/codex/filter-by-name.md): Search for codex items containing a specific name
